name: CastDequant
note: CastDequant<T,U,isVecDeq=true,halfBlock=true>(dst,src,count). CastDeq is the deprecated alias of CastDequant. int32->half path: dst=src*g_deqValue (deqScale set via SetDeqScale(half); the 131072 factors cancel). Other path src:int16 dst:int8/uint8 uses bit-packed g_deqScale.
